title: 搬走前 30 天通知，英语怎么说？
summary: 美国租房搬走一般要提前 30 天书面通知房东，不然可能扣押金。这篇教你怎么说。

featuredPhrase.en: I'd like to give my 30-day notice.
featuredPhrase.zh: 我要提前 30 天通知搬走。

phrases.en: I'd like to give my 30-day notice.
phrases.zh: 我要提前 30 天通知搬走。

phrases.en: I will be moving out at the end of next month.
When will I get my deposit back?
Do I need to clean the apartment?
phrases.zh: 需要把房子打扫干净吗？

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like to give my 30-day notice.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我要提前 30 天通知搬走。

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.en: Okay. When is your last day?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.en: Got it. Please leave the place clean.
dialogue.zh: 知道了。走的时候把房子打扫干净。

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.en: Will do. When will I get my deposit back?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.en: Within 30 days after you move out.

seoTitle: 搬走通知英文怎么说？30 天 notice
seoDescription: 在美国退租搬走，提前 30 天通知房东怎么说？本文教你退租的实用英语和完整对话。
